strings.en: He has awoken, he has awoken...

strings.jp: だけど過去の記憶が無いなんて・・・
strings.en: But to have no memory of the past...

strings.jp: これが罰？それとも罪の報い！？
strings.en: Is this punishment? Or the wages of sin!?

Month ?, Day ? -- Rain
I sin, again and again...

strings.jp:
それを償う事もせず、
また罪を犯す・・・
strings.en: never atoning, and sinning once more...

strings.jp: 嫌なアタシ
strings.en: Hateful me

strings.jp: 恥知らずなアタシ・・・
strings.en: Shameless me...

strings.jp:
アタシは有りもしない夢を見てる
だけかもしれない・・・
strings.en: Perhaps I'm only dreaming of something that can never be...

strings.jp:
熱病に侵されてるだけ
かも知れない・・・
strings.en: Perhaps I'm only sick with fever...

strings.jp:
怯えてるの　忘れたいの
それとも誰かに抱かれたいの・・・・
strings.en: Am I afraid? Do I want to forget? Or do I want someone to hold me....

strings.en: Shameless me...

strings.jp:
いつまでも目覚めないアンタを
思い続ける事は・・・
strings.en: Going on thinking of you, who never wake...

strings.jp:
口に出さなきゃ、
誰にも非難されないアタシの秘め事・・・
strings.en: is my secret, which no one can condemn, so long as I don't say it aloud...

strings.jp: だけどアタシの心の中に・・・
strings.en: But in my heart...

strings.jp:
罪という名のナイフが刺さり、
愛と言う血が涙を流す・・・
strings.en: a knife called sin is stuck, and blood called love sheds tears...

strings.jp: 出会いが罪？
strings.en: Is meeting you a sin?

strings.jp: 想いが罪・・・？
strings.en: Is longing a sin...?

strings.jp: だからアンタは目覚めない・・・？
strings.en: Is that why you don't wake...?

strings.jp: 今日で何日・・・
strings.en: How many days today...

strings.jp: 明日は何日・・・？
strings.en: How many days tomorrow...?

strings.jp:
アタシの手首のためらい傷が、
アンタの眠りの日付の証し・・・
strings.en: The hesitation scars on my wrist are the proof of the days you've slept...

strings.jp: 時が経っても・・・
strings.en: Even as time passes...

strings.jp:
忘れられない痛みだって
ある・・・
strings.en: some pain can't be forgotten...

strings.jp: 泣きたいときに、
strings.en: When they want to cry,

strings.jp: 泣けない人だっている・・・
strings.en: some people can't cry...

strings.jp:
涙を流せば、忘れられるなんて、
いい加減な嘘、
strings.en: That shedding tears lets you forget is a careless lie,

strings.jp: その程度の思い・・・
strings.en: a feeling of that little worth...

strings.jp: 所詮人は一人なんだと・・・
strings.en: That, in the end, people are alone...

strings.jp:
言われてしまえば
それまでだけど・・・
strings.en: If that's said, then that's that, but...

strings.jp: それでもアンタの・・・
strings.en: Even so, your...

strings.jp: アンタの笑顔がもう一度見たい・・・
strings.en: I want to see your smile one more time...

strings.en: I fear the night...

strings.en: The dream in which he vanishes...

strings.en: The more I wish, the more I search...

あの人が消える夢・・・
・・・・・
strings.en: The dream in which he vanishes... .....

strings.jp:
あの人が消える・・・
アタシの腕から消える・・・
strings.en: He vanishes... vanishes from my arms...

strings.jp: 夢で済むなら消えないで・・・
strings.en: If it's only a dream, then don't vanish...
